description: This file defines a final class 'MimeType' within the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, providing static methods to determine the MIME type of a file based on its filename extension. It primarily includes a method to extract the extension from a filename and a method to map extensions to MIME types using a static associative array.

classes.name: MimeType
classes.description: A utility class for determining MIME types from filenames and extensions.

methods.name: fromFilename
methods.description: Returns the MIME type based on the filename's extension by extracting it and mapping it.

methods.name: fromExtension
methods.description: Maps a given file extension to its corresponding MIME type using an internal static array.
